Evidence: `_secret_provider` sets `human_required = (not present) and (not optional)` at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/config_inventory.py:1498`, so present-but-unloadable Anthropic auth becomes `needs_setup` with no safe command but `human_required=False`; `collect_inventory` only emits the response-level dashboard hint when `any(i.human_required for i in items)` at `config_inventory.py:1902`. Targeted check returned `needs_setup False None False`. Recommendation: required secret/auth items that are absent, unloadable, or invalid should be human-required, while optional integrations remain optional/non-blocking.
